programs.title: Adventure Gold Diggers
programs.desc: The Clermont Diggers are under pressure to repay $15,000 worth of gold to their investor or they risk losing their mine. The Mineshaft Hunters enter a dangerous abandoned gold mine with hopes of hitting the motherload. Gold snipers Levi and Rob battle the Tasmanian wilderness to get to a secret river system they've nicknamed The Honey Hole.

programs.title: Aussie Salvage Squad
programs.desc: Team Salvage are in flood-ravaged Lismore in NSW to recover a P3 Orion spy plane. Newcomers Team Edge Recovery put their reputation on the line at a major car rally event in Victoria.

programs.title: Mighty Ships
programs.desc: FPSO Maersk Peregrino is the most expensive single project in Maersk history; she is the world's biggest oil production ship and will be permanently hooked up at the Peregrino oilfield off the coast of Rio de Janeiro.

programs.title: Storage Wars
programs.desc: Back in Montebello, Brandi and her buddy set the wayback machine and discover a roaring good time. Darrell makes the most of the little he's got. And Kenny fills his piggy bank, while courting an unfamiliar pastime.

programs.title: American Pickers
programs.desc: The deals are flying when a Colorado property turns out to be a mega-pick. Then the guys visit a one-of-a-kind classic car collection where they bid huge money on a 1961 Messerschmitt.

programs.title: Pawn Stars
programs.desc: The Pawn Stars crew deals with some of the most dangerous and deadly items to ever come through the doors.
